exposures.item: NBS L20 requires every external door to be 60 minute fire rated, including the doors inside the curtain walling. B1-D + B1-E + B2-E = GBP 54,061.06, 48.9% of the benchmark, is priced on non-fire-rated product. No fire-door supplier has quoted anything, and the tender returns tomorrow.

The BSW enquiry that landed 28/07 15:22 EXCLUDES all fire-rated door leaves and doorsets unless BSW can certify them, so their return will not close the gap above - it will arrive with a hole in exactly that place.
The whole pack is Senior Architectural Systems and no fabricator on our supply chain makes Senior. Every rate in the benchmark comes from non-Senior quotes plus a hand-applied +15% judgement premium.

The Logikal element drawings issued with the BSW enquiry state quantities 6 units short of the trade bill (dwg 008 says 6 against 8, dwg 005 says 1 against 4, dwg 004 says 1 against 2). Schedule 222P is in the pack this time, but a fabricator prices from the element drawing in front of them.
L20 demands U 1.2 W/m2K on the same doors it requires to be 60 minute fire rated. Nobody has confirmed that combination is achievable, so we may be pricing to a specification that cannot be built.
exposures.our_recourse: ask JHA through Stainforth - a conflict inside the architect's own specification

exposures.item: L20 instructs the reader to refer to dwg 2024-055-114 Building 01 Fire Plan and the fire consultant's comments before any order is placed. That drawing is not in the 55-file tender pack at all, so which doors are 60 minute and where is not established from the documents we hold.
exposures.our_recourse: ask Stainforth for the fire plan

exposures.item: Bill B1-C, a window 1500 x 1255-1150, has no drawing anywhere in the pack, and bill B1-A, the access hatch, has a drawing (Logikal 001) that was never attached to any RFQ. Both are priced or carried without a supplier having seen them.
Gintare's steel-door enquiry of 28/07 15:31 shows no recipient on our copy and nothing has come back. If it went nowhere, the steel-core half of the 60 minute package has not been asked for at all.

The work package description behind the Once For All 'View enquiry' link has never been opened, so we do not know what qualifications are permitted, what we would sign, or what price validity is demanded.
